en: A man who returned alive from war.
But his home had burned to nothing.

ko: 이웃이자 친구였던 킬루가 그의 가문을 짓밟았다.
en: Killu, once a neighbor and friend, had crushed his family.

ko: 아내는 몸종으로 끌려가 온갖 몹쓸 짓을 당했고,
en: His wife was taken as a servant and suffered unspeakable horrors,

ko: 끝내 못 이겨 스스로 목숨을 끊었다.
en: until she could bear no more and took her own life.

ko: 아이들은 노예로 팔려가 어디에 있는지조차 알 수 없다.
en: His children were sold into slavery — their fate unknown.

ko: 늙은 부모는 감옥에 갇혀 굶어 죽었다.
en: His elderly parents were imprisoned and starved to death.
Everyone in the Killu household knew.
Thirty-one of them saw everything and looked away.

ko: 그날 밤, 킬루 가문을 모두 죽였다.
en: That night, he killed every last one of them.
He cut off Killu's limbs with a blade,
cauterized the wounds with fire,
and kept him alive for a long, long time.
"Remember."
"And regret it even in hell."
And so he fell into hell.

ko: "...이것은 셀 수 없는 복수자 중 하나의 이야기일 뿐."
en: "...This is but one tale among countless avengers."
"Every day, new souls fall into hell's labyrinth."

ko: "분노로 가득 찬 자, 억울함에 미친 자, 사랑을 잃은 자..."
en: "Those consumed by rage, driven mad by injustice, those who lost love..."
"Why have you come to hell?"
"Escape from hell."
"You... who bear the weight of sin."
